name: CoraPOS
title: Bringing order to the counter
description: Our earlier point-of-sale and inventory management product. It laid the groundwork for how we approach everyday business software.
summary: An earlier point-of-sale and inventory management product.
overview: CoraPOS was one of our earlier products: a point-of-sale and inventory management system for businesses that sell and keep stock.
Building it shaped how we think about everyday business software, which needs to be fast at the counter and dependable behind it.
standing: An earlier product. Its lessons carry into the business tools we build today.
